name: Crystal Cave
desc: Underground cavern bristling with glowing crystal clusters on ceiling and floor, each spire pulsing softly out of phase, a luminous pool rippling at the cave floor with drips falling from stalactites, floating mist motes, and a slow breathing ambient glow that wanders the chamber. Styles: amethyst, emerald, blue ice, fire opal, and a hue-dialed custom.
